contact-extractor.name: contact-extractor
contact-extractor.title: Email Extractor — Website Contact & Social Finder
contact-extractor.description: Email Extractor finds every e-mail address, phone number and social profile on a website — one clean row per domain, ready for outreach.

tech-stack-detector.name: tech-stack-detector
tech-stack-detector.title: Tech Stack Detector — Wappalyzer & BuiltWith Alternative
tech-stack-detector.description: Tech Stack Detector finds the CMS, e-commerce platform, analytics, ad pixels, chat widget and payment provider any website runs — one row per domain.

core-web-vitals-audit.name: core-web-vitals-audit
core-web-vitals-audit.title: Bulk Core Web Vitals & PageSpeed Audit
core-web-vitals-audit.description: Bulk Core Web Vitals and PageSpeed audit: Lighthouse performance, SEO and accessibility scores, LCP, CLS, INP, TBT and the top fixes — one row per URL and device.

package-health-checker.name: package-health-checker
package-health-checker.title: npm, PyPI & Crates.io Package Health Checker
package-health-checker.description: Package health checker for npm, PyPI and Crates.io — deprecation, last publish date, licence, weekly downloads, maintainers, GitHub stars and a 0-100 health score, one row per package.

hiring-signals.name: hiring-signals
hiring-signals.title: Hiring Signals Scraper (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable)
hiring-signals.description: Scrape company job postings and hiring signals from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workable job boards — one row per job, or one hiring summary per company.

dns-email-security-checker.name: dns-email-security-checker
dns-email-security-checker.title: Domain DNS & Email Security Checker
dns-email-security-checker.description: Domain DNS & Email Security Checker returns SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, BIMI, CAA, nameservers, registrar and domain age for every domain you give it — one scored row per domain.

subdomain-finder.name: subdomain-finder
subdomain-finder.title: Subdomain Finder (Certificate Transparency)
subdomain-finder.description: Subdomain Finder enumerates every subdomain of a domain from Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh, Cert Spotter) and resolves each one — one row per subdomain, no proxies needed.

youtube-channel-videos.name: youtube-channel-videos
youtube-channel-videos.title: YouTube Channel Latest Videos (RSS, no API key)
youtube-channel-videos.description: YouTube channel latest videos scraper: give it a channel ID, @handle or channel URL and get the newest uploads with title, URL, views, likes, description and thumbnail — one row per video, no API key.

sitemap-extractor.name: sitemap-extractor
sitemap-extractor.title: Sitemap URL Extractor & Change Monitor
sitemap-extractor.description: Sitemap URL extractor that reads robots.txt, sitemap indexes, .xml.gz and plain-text sitemaps and returns one row per URL with lastmod, changefreq, priority — plus a new/removed diff between runs.

structured-data-extractor.name: structured-data-extractor
structured-data-extractor.title: Structured Data & JSON-LD Extractor (Schema.org, Open Graph)
structured-data-extractor.description: Structured Data & JSON-LD Extractor reads every Schema.org JSON-LD block and Open Graph tag on a page and returns one clean row per URL — product, price, rating, article, job posting, event, recipe, FAQ and breadcrumb data, ready for RAG pipelines and SEO rich-result audits.

wayback-page-diff.name: wayback-page-diff
wayback-page-diff.title: Wayback Machine Snapshot & Page Change Tracker
wayback-page-diff.description: Wayback Machine Snapshot & Page Change Tracker lists every Internet Archive capture of a URL and diffs the visible text of the oldest vs. newest snapshot in range — one scored change row per URL, or a full snapshot list.

app-store-lookup.name: app-store-lookup
app-store-lookup.title: App Store (iOS) App Metadata, Ratings & Top Charts Lookup
app-store-lookup.description: App Store lookup for iOS apps: ratings, price, version, update date, size, genres and description from any app id, bundle id, store URL or search term — plus Top Free and Top Paid charts.

press-release-monitor.name: press-release-monitor
press-release-monitor.title: Press Release Monitor: PR Newswire, BusinessWire, GlobeNewswire
press-release-monitor.description: Press Release Monitor returns keyword-matched press releases from PR Newswire, Business Wire and GlobeNewswire RSS feeds — company, publish date, category and summary, one row per release.

vscode-marketplace-extensions.name: vscode-marketplace-extensions
vscode-marketplace-extensions.title: VS Code Marketplace Extension Scraper (installs, ratings)
vscode-marketplace-extensions.description: VS Code Marketplace Extension Scraper returns installs, ratings, version, categories, tags, repository and license for any VS Code extension id, marketplace URL or search keyword — one row per extension.

github-repo-health.name: github-repo-health
github-repo-health.title: GitHub Repository Health & Activity Report
github-repo-health.description: GitHub Repository Health & Activity Report returns stars, commit activity, contributors, latest release and community-health files for any repo list or org:<name> — one scored row per repo.

crossref-doi-lookup.name: crossref-doi-lookup
crossref-doi-lookup.title: CrossRef DOI & Citation Metadata Lookup
crossref-doi-lookup.description: CrossRef DOI & Citation Metadata Lookup resolves DOIs, DOI URLs or citations via the CrossRef API and returns title, authors, journal, citation count, abstract and license — one row per item.

ical-calendar-extractor.name: ical-calendar-extractor
ical-calendar-extractor.title: iCal / ICS Calendar Feed to Events Extractor
ical-calendar-extractor.description: iCal / ICS Calendar Feed to Events Extractor reads any ICS or webcal:// URL and returns one row per event instance, expanding RRULE recurring events within a date window, with times converted to UTC.

chrome-web-store-extensions.name: chrome-web-store-extensions
chrome-web-store-extensions.title: Chrome Web Store Extension Scraper (installs, ratings)
chrome-web-store-extensions.description: Chrome Web Store Extension Scraper returns users, rating, version, size, category and developer contact for any Chrome extension id or store URL — one row per extension.

shopify-products-scraper.name: shopify-products-scraper
shopify-products-scraper.title: Shopify Store Products Scraper
shopify-products-scraper.description: Shopify Store Products Scraper reads any Shopify store's public products.json feed — title, price, compare-at price, discount %, stock, SKU and images, one row per product or variant.

domain-security-audit.name: domain-security-audit
domain-security-audit.title: Domain Security Audit (TLS, HTTP headers, redirects, robots)
domain-security-audit.description: Domain Security Audit checks TLS certificate validity, HSTS/CSP and other HTTP security headers, the redirect chain and robots.txt/llms.txt AI-bot rules for any list of domains — one scored, graded row per domain.

website-to-markdown.name: website-to-markdown
website-to-markdown.title: Website to Markdown — Content Crawler for LLM & RAG
website-to-markdown.description: Content Crawler turns any site into clean Markdown per page for LLMs, RAG pipelines and vector DBs — no headless browser, $1 per 1,000 pages.

yc-companies-scraper.name: yc-companies-scraper
yc-companies-scraper.title: Y Combinator Companies & Founders Scraper
yc-companies-scraper.description: Y Combinator company directory scraper — batch, industry, hiring status, one-liner, description and founder names/titles/LinkedIn/Twitter for every YC-funded startup, one row per company.

article-extractor.name: article-extractor
article-extractor.title: Article & News Extractor (clean text, author, date, markdown)
article-extractor.description: Article & News Extractor returns clean article text, title, author(s), publish/modified date, tags and images from any news or blog URL — one row per URL, as Markdown, plain text or HTML.

youtube-comments-scraper.name: youtube-comments-scraper
youtube-comments-scraper.title: YouTube Comments Scraper — Comments & Replies
youtube-comments-scraper.description: Comments Scraper extracts comments, replies, likes and author details from any YouTube video URL or ID — no YouTube Data API key or quota needed.

google-search-scraper.name: google-search-scraper
google-search-scraper.title: Google Search Results Scraper — SERP API
google-search-scraper.description: Google Search Results Scraper returns organic results (title, real URL, snippet, position) for any query through the Apify GOOGLE_SERP proxy — one row per SERP page, priced per page not per result.

wikidata-entity-enrichment.name: wikidata-entity-enrichment
wikidata-entity-enrichment.title: Wikidata Entity & Company Enrichment (facts, IDs, links)
wikidata-entity-enrichment.description: Wikidata Entity & Company Enrichment resolves a QID, company name, or Wikipedia URL to its Wikidata item and returns facts (country, HQ, founders, CEO, employees, revenue), identifiers (ISIN, Crunchbase, LinkedIn) and social/media links — one row per entity.

openfda-recall-monitor.name: openfda-recall-monitor
openfda-recall-monitor.title: FDA Recalls & Adverse Events Monitor (openFDA)
openfda-recall-monitor.description: FDA Recalls & Adverse Events Monitor returns food, drug and device recalls, drug and device adverse-event reports, and drug labels from openFDA — one flat, scored row per record for a date range you choose.

seo-page-audit.name: seo-page-audit
seo-page-audit.title: On-Page SEO Audit
seo-page-audit.description: On-Page SEO Audit checks title, meta description, headings, images, links, Open Graph, Twitter Card and Schema.org data for any list of URLs — one scored row per page.

google-news-scraper.name: google-news-scraper
google-news-scraper.title: Google News Scraper (RSS search by keyword, topic, site)
google-news-scraper.description: Google News Scraper returns headlines from Google News RSS search and topic feeds for any keyword, site: or when: query, and resolves each article's real publisher URL — one row per article.

youtube-channel-scraper.name: youtube-channel-scraper
youtube-channel-scraper.title: YouTube Channel Scraper (videos, shorts, live)
youtube-channel-scraper.description: YouTube Channel Scraper extracts videos, Shorts or livestreams from any YouTube channel — title, views, duration, publish time and thumbnail — no API key or quota needed.

youtube-search-scraper.name: youtube-search-scraper
youtube-search-scraper.title: YouTube Search Results Scraper (videos, channels, no API key)
youtube-search-scraper.description: YouTube Search Results Scraper returns videos, channels or playlists for any keyword, with title, views, duration, channel and publish time — no API key, no quota.

podcast-lookup.name: podcast-lookup
podcast-lookup.title: Apple Podcasts Lookup & Episodes Scraper
podcast-lookup.description: Apple Podcasts lookup by id, URL, RSS feed or search term — podcast metadata (artwork, genres, episode count) plus the full episode list from the show's own RSS feed, one row per podcast or episode.

email-validator.name: email-validator
email-validator.title: Email Validator & Verifier — Bulk Email Check
email-validator.description: Email Validator checks syntax, MX/A DNS records, disposable/free-provider/role classification and typo suggestions for a list of email addresses — one scored row per address, no SMTP mailbox probing.

youtube-video-details.name: youtube-video-details
youtube-video-details.title: YouTube Video Details Scraper (views, likes, description, tags)
youtube-video-details.description: YouTube Video Details Scraper returns views, likes, description, tags, category, channel and comment count for any YouTube video URL or ID — no YouTube Data API key or quota needed.

overpass-poi-extractor.name: overpass-poi-extractor
overpass-poi-extractor.title: OpenStreetMap POI Extractor (Overpass API: shops, amenities)
overpass-poi-extractor.description: OpenStreetMap POI Extractor returns shops, cafes, restaurants and any tagged place within a radius, a bounding box, or a named area — one row per point of interest, powered by the free Overpass API.

ai-web-search.name: ai-web-search
ai-web-search.title: AI Web Search & Read: Google results as clean Markdown
ai-web-search.description: AI Web Search runs a Google search, fetches the top organic results and returns clean Markdown per result — one call turns a question into LLM-ready context for agents, RAG and MCP.

company-360.name: company-360
company-360.title: Company 360: full company profile from a domain
company-360.description: Company 360 turns a domain into one rich profile row: contacts, tech stack, DNS/e-mail security, TLS/security headers, on-page SEO, hiring signals and company facts (HQ, employees, revenue, founders) merged from our own scraper suite.

bluesky-scraper.name: bluesky-scraper
bluesky-scraper.title: Bluesky Post, Search & Profile Scraper
bluesky-scraper.description: Bluesky Post, Search & Profile Scraper returns post text, engagement counts, images, profile bios, followers, follows and thread replies from Bluesky's public API — one row per item, no login required.

google-play-scraper.name: google-play-scraper
google-play-scraper.title: Google Play Scraper
google-play-scraper.description: Google Play Scraper returns app title, developer, rating, price, installs, category, media links, and optional reviews for any package id, Play Store URL or search term — one row per app.

github-trending-scraper.name: github-trending-scraper
github-trending-scraper.title: GitHub Trending Repositories Scraper
github-trending-scraper.description: Scrapes github.com/trending: the daily, weekly or monthly trending repositories or developers, by programming language and spoken language. One row per repo or developer with stars, forks, stars-in-period and description — no API key, no proxies.

hacker-news-scraper.name: hacker-news-scraper
hacker-news-scraper.title: Hacker News Search & Front Page Scraper
hacker-news-scraper.description: Search Hacker News stories, comments, Show HN and Ask HN posts by keyword, or pull the current front page — via the free Algolia HN API, no API key. One row per story or comment with points, author, comment count and text.

domain-whois-rdap.name: domain-whois-rdap
domain-whois-rdap.title: Bulk Domain WHOIS & RDAP Lookup
domain-whois-rdap.description: Bulk domain WHOIS lookup via the official RDAP protocol — registrar, registration/expiry dates, domain age, nameservers, DNSSEC and status codes for any domain, no API key, no rate limits.

market-quotes.name: market-quotes
market-quotes.title: Stock, Crypto & FX Quotes
market-quotes.description: Live-delayed stock, ETF, index, cryptocurrency and foreign-exchange quotes in one call — price, change, day range, volume and optional history, from free public endpoints with no API key.

substack-scraper.name: substack-scraper
substack-scraper.title: Substack Publication & Posts Scraper
substack-scraper.description: Scrapes any Substack publication's own public JSON archive API — title, author, publish date, paywall status, word count, likes and comments per post, one row per post, with an RSS fallback and optional full article text.

telegram-channel-scraper.name: telegram-channel-scraper
telegram-channel-scraper.title: Telegram Channel Posts Scraper
telegram-channel-scraper.description: Scrapes public Telegram channels via the t.me/s/ web preview — post text, view counts, media flags, forwards, replies and links, one row per post, no API key or login required.

stackexchange-scraper.name: stackexchange-scraper
stackexchange-scraper.title: Stack Overflow & Stack Exchange Q&A Scraper
stackexchange-scraper.description: Search Stack Overflow or any Stack Exchange site's free public API by keyword or tag and get one row per question — score, tags, author, view/answer counts and the accepted answer's text.

remote-jobs-aggregator.name: remote-jobs-aggregator
remote-jobs-aggregator.title: Remote Jobs Aggregator (RemoteOK, WWR, Hacker News)
remote-jobs-aggregator.description: Merge and de-duplicate remote job listings from RemoteOK, We Work Remotely and Hacker News' Who is Hiring thread into one clean row per job — title, company, salary, tags and apply link.

css-selector-extractor.name: css-selector-extractor
css-selector-extractor.title: Web Scraper — CSS Selector & Data Extractor
css-selector-extractor.description: Web Scraper pulls any CSS selector off any page, returning text, HTML, attributes or match counts — one row per URL, no browser required.

google-play-reviews-scraper.name: google-play-reviews-scraper
google-play-reviews-scraper.title: Google Play Reviews Scraper
google-play-reviews-scraper.description: Extract reviews, ratings, replies, and app versions from Google Play Store apps by package ID or URL.

youtube-transcript-scraper.name: youtube-transcript-scraper
youtube-transcript-scraper.title: YouTube Transcript Scraper
youtube-transcript-scraper.description: Extract YouTube video transcripts, captions, and subtitles in JSON format with segments and timestamps. Supports multiple languages and auto-generated captions.

google-trends-scraper.name: google-trends-scraper
google-trends-scraper.title: Google Trends Scraper
google-trends-scraper.description: Google Trends Scraper extracts search interest data from Google Trends by keyword, including interest over time, regional interest, and related search queries.

website-screenshot.name: website-screenshot
website-screenshot.title: Website Screenshot Generator
website-screenshot.description: Generate full-page or viewport screenshots of websites in PNG or JPEG format. Fast, reliable screenshots with customizable viewport size, wait time, and element hiding.

linkedin-jobs-scraper.name: linkedin-jobs-scraper
linkedin-jobs-scraper.title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper
linkedin-jobs-scraper.description: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper returns public job listings from LinkedIn by keywords, location, and filters. Scrape job titles, companies, salaries, descriptions, and applicant counts from LinkedIn's public guest job search API.

youtube-shorts-scraper.name: youtube-shorts-scraper
youtube-shorts-scraper.title: YouTube Shorts Scraper
youtube-shorts-scraper.description: YouTube Shorts Scraper collects Shorts from channels, #hashtag feeds and Shorts search — video ID, URL, title, view count, channel and thumbnail per Short, with no API key or quota.

seek-jobs-scraper.name: seek-jobs-scraper
seek-jobs-scraper.title: Seek Jobs Scraper (Australia & New Zealand)
seek-jobs-scraper.description: Scrape job listings from Seek.com.au and Seek.co.nz. Extract job details including title, company, location, salary, work type, and description.

google-ads-transparency-scraper.name: google-ads-transparency-scraper
google-ads-transparency-scraper.title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper
google-ads-transparency-scraper.description: Google Ads Transparency Scraper extracts ad creatives from Google's Ad Transparency Center. Search by advertiser domain, advertiser ID, or name, filter by region and date range, and retrieve creative details including text, images, video previews, and show/hide dates.

career-site-jobs-api.name: career-site-jobs-api
career-site-jobs-api.title: Career Site Jobs API (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday +1)
career-site-jobs-api.description: Career Site Jobs API finds which ATS a company uses (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday) from its domain or name and returns its open jobs in one unified format, $3 per 1,000 jobs.

google-maps-scraper.name: google-maps-scraper
google-maps-scraper.title: Google Maps Scraper
google-maps-scraper.description: Google Maps Scraper extracts places from Google Maps search: name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count, coordinates and today's hours, in any country, no browser, $2 per 1,000 places.

aliexpress-scraper.name: aliexpress-scraper
aliexpress-scraper.title: AliExpress Scraper (Search Products & Prices)
aliexpress-scraper.description: Scrape AliExpress search results by keyword: product id, title, price in USD, discount, image, sponsored flag and position. Sort by price, filter by price range. No login.

wellfound-jobs-scraper.name: wellfound-jobs-scraper
wellfound-jobs-scraper.title: Wellfound Jobs Scraper (AngelList Startup Jobs)
wellfound-jobs-scraper.description: Scrape startup jobs from Wellfound (AngelList Talent) by role and city or remote: title, salary and equity ranges, job type, location, posted date, description, and the company’s size, stage and tagline. No login.

trustpilot-reviews-scraper.name: trustpilot-reviews-scraper
trustpilot-reviews-scraper.title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper (Ratings, Replies, No Login)
trustpilot-reviews-scraper.description: Scrape Trustpilot reviews for any company: star rating, title, full text, language, dates, verification, reviewer country and the company’s reply, plus TrustScore and review count. Real browser, no login or cookies needed.

x-tweet-scraper.name: x-tweet-scraper
x-tweet-scraper.title: X Tweet Scraper (Twitter Posts by URL, No Login)
x-tweet-scraper.description: Get full details of X (Twitter) posts from their URLs or ids: text, date, likes, replies, author, verification, hashtags, mentions, links, photos, videos (MP4), link cards, quotes and replies. No login, cookies or API key.

llms-txt-generator.name: llms-txt-generator
llms-txt-generator.title: llms.txt Generator (Website to llms.txt & llms-full.txt)
llms-txt-generator.description: Turn any website or docs site into an llms.txt (sectioned links with one-line descriptions) and llms-full.txt (every page as clean Markdown) for AI assistants, RAG and AI search. Plain HTTP, sitemap-aware, robots.txt-friendly.

pdf-to-markdown.name: pdf-to-markdown
pdf-to-markdown.title: PDF to Markdown Converter (Text, Headings, Metadata)
pdf-to-markdown.description: Convert PDF files to clean Markdown for LLMs and RAG: headings detected from font sizes, paragraphs joined, page headers, footers and page numbers removed, plus title, author, dates, page count, links and token count. Give PDF URLs or pages that link to PDFs.

rag-text-chunker.name: rag-text-chunker
rag-text-chunker.title: RAG Text Chunker (Markdown to Chunks, Token Counts)
rag-text-chunker.description: Split Markdown or text into RAG-ready chunks with exact OpenAI token counts (o200k/cl100k): heading-aware, code blocks kept whole, sentence-boundary overlap, heading path on every chunk. Chunks any dataset from Website to Markdown, PDF to Markdown or your own texts.
